_note: Published reference numbers for orientation only. Values are APPROXIMATE (from the cited papers' headline results); each entry carries verified=false until checked against the source table. Metrics differ in protocol (evaluation masks, lesion-wise rules), so compare like with like.

wmh2017.name: WMH Segmentation Challenge 2017 (MICCAI), test set, top entry (sysu_media) and challenge summary
wmh2017.citation: Kuijf HJ, et al. IEEE TMI 2019;38(11):2556-2568
wmh2017.protocol: voxel Dice, H95, AVD, lesion-wise recall/F1 (any-voxel overlap, 26-connectivity) on 110 test subjects, 3 scanners

isbi2015.name: ISBI 2015 longitudinal MS lesion challenge: inter-rater agreement and top automated entries
isbi2015.protocol: inter-rater Dice ~0.63 between the two human raters; leading automated methods reach comparable Dice (challenge score ~90 = human level)

msseg2016.name: MICCAI MSSEG 2016: best automated methods vs 7-expert consensus
msseg2016.citation: Commowick O, et al. Sci Rep 2018;8:13650
msseg2016.protocol: Dice vs consensus on 38 test subjects; expert-vs-consensus Dice ~0.66-0.79

lst_lpa_lga.name: LST toolbox (LGA / LPA) typical MS-lesion Dice on 3T FLAIR
lst_lpa_lga.citation: Schmidt P, et al. NeuroImage 2012;59(4):3774-3783 (LGA); Schmidt P. PhD thesis LMU 2017 (LPA)
lst_lpa_lga.protocol: LGA kappa=0.3 Dice ~0.75 at high lesion load in the original paper, ~0.5-0.6 in independent evaluations; LPA similar

shifts_ms.name: Shifts 2.0 MS lesion segmentation baseline (nnU-Net-style ensemble)
shifts_ms.protocol: in-distribution test Dice; degrades under scanner/site shift

ds004199.name: OpenNeuro ds004199 FCD lesions (no published automated-detection baseline in the dataset paper)
ds004199.citation: Schuch F, et al. Sci Data 2023;10:475
ds004199.protocol: 85 healthy controls: any detection is a false positive; FCD lesions are cortical/subcortical (not brainstem)
